title: Unconventional resistivity reduction in NbP semimetal nanoribbons
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11288-8

Niobium phosphide semimetal nanoribbons show decreasing resistivity with decreasing width, unlike the classical behaviour of metals such as copper, offering a platform for nanoscale wires and interconnects via industry-friendly top-down nanofabrication.
